The output noise power $P_{out}$ is given by the integral of the output power spectral density $S_{out}(f)$ over all frequencies.
$S_{out}(f) = S_{in}(f) |H(f)|^2$.

$|H(f)|^2 = \left| \frac{1}{1 + j(f/f_c)} \right|^2 = \frac{1}{1 + (f/f_c)^2}$.

Case 1: Two-sided PSD $S_{in}(f) = \frac{\eta}{2}$.
$P_{out} = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} S_{in}(f) |H(f)|^2 df$
$P_{out} = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \frac{\eta}{2} \frac{1}{1 + (f/f_c)^2} df$
Let $x = f/f_c$, so $df = f_c dx$.
$P_{out} = \frac{\eta}{2} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \frac{1}{1 + x^2} f_c dx$
$P_{out} = \frac{\eta f_c}{2} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \frac{1}{1 + x^2} dx$
The integral $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \frac{1}{1 + x^2} dx = [\arctan(x)]_{-\infty}^{\infty} = \frac{\pi}{2} - (-\frac{\pi}{2}) = \pi$.
$P_{out} = \frac{\eta f_c}{2} \cdot \pi = \frac{\eta f_c \pi}{2}$.

$P_{out} = \eta f_c \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{1 + x^2} dx$
$\int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{1 + x^2} dx = [\arctan(x)]_{0}^{\infty} = \frac{\pi}{2}$.
$P_{out} = \eta f_c \frac{\pi}{2} = \frac{\eta f_c \pi}{2}$.
